synopsis: Lord Brooke of Alverthorpe's full title is The Lord Brooke of Alverthorpe. His name is Clive Brooke, and he is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Drugs: Sales
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of the potential use of AI to detect and disrupt the online sale of illegal drugs; and what resources, if any, are currently being devoted to doing this.

history.heading: House of Lords: Parliamentary Questions
history.questionText: To ask The Senior Deputy Speaker why there is a limit on the number of oral and written questions that Members of the House of Lords may table to scrutinise the performance and the legislation of His Majesty's Government.

history.heading: Amendments and New Clauses
history.questionText: To ask The Senior Deputy Speaker why there is no limitation on the number of amendments that Members of the House of Lords may table to legislation.

history.questionText: To ask The Leader of the House what steps they are taking, if any, to develop a methodology for assessing the cost of answering written questions; and, if so, whether this involves the use of artificial intelligence.
history.answeringBodyName: Leader of the House of Lords

history.heading: Written Questions
history.questionText: To ask The Senior Deputy Speaker how many written questions were tabled in 2025.

history.heading: Written Questions: Peers' Interests
history.questionText: To ask The Senior Deputy Speaker how many written questions tabled in 2025 contained a declaration of a peer's relevant interest; whether those declarations of interest were published; and, if not, why not.

history.heading: Addictions: Greater London
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government where homeless people in London with drink and drug addiction problems can be detoxed now that London’s sole remaining Addiction Clinical Care Suite and Detox Unit has closed at St Thomas’ Hospital.

history.heading: Young People: Employment
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they are taking to ensure that education, training and employment policies prepare young people and the unemployed for jobs requiring human empathy, compassion, interpersonal relationships and care.
